design.layout: The page features a centered headline and uppercase eyebrow followed by a large, two-column rounded container. The left column handles interactive inputs (radio buttons, sliders, checkboxes), while the right column acts as a summary panel containing stacked price cards.
design.mood: High-end dark mode utility: professional, precise, and authoritative with a punch of vibrant urgency.
guardrails: Avoid adding distracting background patterns or illustrations; keep it pure pitch black.
Do not use borders around the input fields; prefer subtle dividers and whitespace.
Ensure the gradient CTA card is the brightest element on the page; don't dilute its impact with other gradients.
Avoid standard system fonts; stick to geometric sans-serifs for the premium tech look.
design.motion: Subtle numeric rolling effect for the price totals as the user interacts with the form. Slider handles should have a slight elastic expansion on hover. Values should transition with a crisp fade and 50ms slide-up motion.
design.centerpiece: Interactive calculator card with a dual-pane layout: a dark input form on the left and dynamic pricing results on the right.
